items.title: Show HN: UAC-Less Sudo for Windows
items.contentSnippet:
I started this project around 8 years ago out of frustration with the lack of a proper sudo command for Windows, and then abandoned it for a while. I was excited to see Microsoft create an official one, but it seems to be abandoned, so I picked this project back up. Once installed, this will never show a UAC prompt, which is different from every other sudo for Windows I've seen.

items.title: Show HN: Theseus the Mouse by Claude S. (and Claude O.)
items.contentSnippet:
Ruuning sim is here: https://rupello.github.io/theseus/
For the full experience click on the 'Relay clicks' checkbox on the right side below the maze
The simulation was entirely built by Claude (Opus 5) & may not be historically accurate as I couldn't find any documentation of the wiring.
I prompted Claude to build a simulation using three.js, then added the relay visualization & then the ladder logic. Finally, I asked Claude to refactor the code & add descriptive documentation for readability.
